name: View-dependent color with Spherical Harmonics
definition: A technique to model view-dependent appearance (e.g., reflections) in 3D Gaussian Splatting by representing the color of each Gaussian as a function of the viewing direction using spherical harmonics coefficients, rather than a single static color value.
summary: View-dependent color with Spherical Harmonics models directional appearance in 3D Gaussian Splatting by storing coefficients that generate view-varying colors, avoiding per-ray neural queries for efficient specular rendering.
